page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6t.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. It does not feature any integrated graphics processing units (GPUs). For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

The ecs.g6t.8xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for workloads requiring a steady ratio of compute power to memory. Its dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This configuration is appropriate for general-purpose applications, medium-sized databases, web serving, and enterprise application hosting where local storage is not a primary requirement.
